# reselling_ssh_key (Resource)

A public SSH key stored in the account. Its id goes into `ssh_key_ids` of `reselling_rootserver`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "reselling_ssh_key" "admin" {
  name       = "admin"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the key.
- `public_key` (String) Public key in OpenSSH format (`ssh-ed25519`, `ssh-rsa`, `ecdsa-sha2-nistp256/384/521`). Changing it replaces the key.

### Optional

- `is_default` (Boolean) Mark the key as default key of the account. Only applied on creation.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) SHA256 fingerprint.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key_type` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import reselling_ssh_key.admin <ssh_key_id>
```
